liveExecutionReason: AU V11 now has scheduled shadow monitoring, near-jump burst checks and automated 21-stream post-race state tracking, but no authenticated bookmaker execution adapter and accepted-fill callback are configured. Real-money unattended execution stays locked.

architecture.serverReason: A phone/browser can sleep, close, lose connectivity or suspend background JavaScript. Server shadow evaluation and post-race state tracking now run independently; real unattended wagering still requires an authenticated execution adapter, fill callback, exposure control and kill switch.

nearJumpBurst.purpose: Once a watched race is within three minutes, the server performs short high-frequency shadow checks so the 20s→10s V11 window is not dependent on a one-minute cron tick.

shadowBackend.note: This worker independently reads the trusted AU watchlist and evaluates V11 shadow state even if the browser is closed. It cannot submit a wager.

stateTracker.stateRule: Favourite WIN resets state to 0; favourite LOSS increments state by 1. State tracking is independent from whether a system wager was placed.

crossSourceVerification.conflictRule: If sources disagree on favourite identity but imply the same W/L outcome, record the unambiguous outcome and audit both names. If they imply different outcomes, do not guess: mark REVIEW_REQUIRED and leave the state unresolved.

stateTracker.note: This removes most of the manual weekly 21-stream state-entry work while failing closed on cross-source ambiguity.
